Intrinsically <barrier/>Anti-Barrier.

Holding down the trigger for 16 rounds makes the 16th round <void/>Weaken for 6 Seconds and grants 'Vexadecimal'. 

Vexadecemial <title refills [G_refill] /> 12 ammo from reserves on trigger release as long as the current magazine isn't empty.

(Currently only <void/>Weakens after 32 uninterrupted rounds)
